title: 52 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Banking & Money)
description:
Learn 52 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 52 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

PHRASE LIST

BANKING & MONEY · 银行与金钱
• What documents do you need? - 你们需要哪些材料？  [Ni men xu yao na xie cai liao?]
• I want to withdraw cash now. - 我想现在取现。  [Wo xiang xian zai qu xian.]
• Is there a foreign ATM fee? - 境外取款有手续费吗？  [Jing wai qu kuan you shou xu fei ma?]
• How long will the wire take? - 汇款要多久才能到账？  [Hui kuan yao duo jiu cai neng da zhang?]
• Do you offer student account? - 你们有学生账户吗？  [Ni men you xue sheng zhang hu ma?]
• Can I set a weekly budget? - 我能设周预算吗？  [Wo neng she zhou yu suan ma?]

PURPOSE · 目标
• I want clarity, not chaos. - 我想要清晰，不要混乱。  [Wǒ xiǎngyào qīngxī, bú yào hùanluàn.]
• Tell me the next right step. - 告诉我下一步该做什么。  [Gàosu wǒ xiàyí bù gāi zuò shénme.]
• Set a goal, then protect it. - 先定目标，再守住它。  [Xiān dìng mùbiāo, zài shǒuzhù tā.]
• My goal is growth this month. - 这个月我的目标是成长。  [Zhège yuè wǒ de mùbiāo shì chéngzhǎng.]
• I aim high, but stay realistic. - 我定高目标，但保持现实。  [Wǒ dìng gāo mùbiāo, dàn bǎochí xiànshí.]
• Make it measurable, then act. - 把目标量化，然后去做。  [Bǎ mùbiāo liànghuà, ránhòu qù zuò.]
• What can I finish today? - 我今天能完成什么？  [Wǒ jīntiān néng wánchéng shénme?]

GROWTH · 成长
• Turn setbacks into fresh practice - 把挫折变成新的练习  [bǎ CUÒzhé biàn chéng xīn de LIANxí]
• Learn to like the process - 学会享受过程  [xuéhuì XIANGshòu guòchéng]
• Grow by doing one thing daily - 每天做一件小事就会成长  [měi tiān zuò yí jiàn xiǎo shì jiù huì chéngzhǎng]
• Make room for slow improvement - 为慢慢进步留出空间  [wèi MÀNman jìnbù liú chū kōngjiān]
• Be brave enough to start messy - 别怕把事情先做得很乱  [bié pà bǎ shìqíng xiān zuò de hěn luàn]
• Ask why, then try a new method - 先问原因，再换个方法试试  [xiān wèn yuányīn, zài huàn gè fāngfǎ shì shì]

COMMON NATIVE SLANG · 常用本土俚语
• No way, that s hilarious - 不可能吧，太好笑了  [bu KE neng ba, tai hao xiao le]
• You re low-key flexing, huh - 你这是在暗暗炫耀吧  [ni zhe shi zai an an xuan yao ba]
• I m down, let s do it - 行啊，我可以，咱们就去  [xing a, wo ke yi, zan men jiu qu]
• Give me a sec, okay? - 等一下，马上就来  [deng yi xia, ma shang jiu lai]
• That s not gonna fly - 这事儿不行，别想了  [zhe shi er bu xing, bie xiang le]
• I m exhausted, for real - 我累死了，真的  [wo lei si le, zhen de]
• Stop messing around, please - 别闹了，认真点  [bie nao le, ren zhen dian]

WORK & OFFICE · 工作与办公室
• I’ll send it after the meeting. - 会后我就把它发过去。  [HUI HOU wo JIU ba ta fa GUO QU]
• Can you share the latest draft? - 你能把最新的草稿发我吗？  [NI neng ba ZUI XIN de CAO GAO fa wo ma]
• Let’s align on next steps. - 我们先把下一步对齐吧。  [Women XIAN ba xia yi bu dui QI ba]
• Who should approve this decision? - 这项决定谁来审批？  [Zhe xiang JUE DING shui lai shen PI]
• I need this by end of day. - 我需要今天下班前拿到。  [Wo xu yao jin tian xia ban qian na dao]
• We’re behind schedule, right? - 我们进度有点落后，对吧？  [Wo men jin du you dian luo hou, dui ba]
• Could we move this to tomorrow? - 我们能不能挪到明天？  [Ke yi meng neng nuo dao ming tian]

JOY · 快乐
• Joy is in the ordinary - 快乐藏在日常的小细节里  [kuài lè zàng zài rì cháng de xiǎo xì jié lǐ]
• I feel calm, and glad - 我又安心又开心  [wǒ yòu ān xīn yòu kāi xīn]
• Sunlight makes everything better - 阳光一照，心里就亮了  [yáng guāng yì zhào, xīn lǐ jiù liàng le]
• A fresh start feels great - 重新开始也太舒服了  [chóng xīn kāi shǐ yě tài shū fu le]
• I did it, I’m proud - 我做到了，我很自豪  [wǒ zuò dào le, wǒ hěn zì háo]
• My heart feels steady - 我的心稳稳的  [wǒ de xīn wěn wěn de]
• I’m enjoying this morning - 我很享受这个早晨  [wǒ hěn xiǎng shòu zhè ge zǎo chén]

WISDOM · 智慧
• Notice patterns before they repeat - 先看清规律，再等爆发点  [Xiān kàn qīng guīlǜ, zài děng bào fā diǎn.]
• Let curiosity lead, not fear - 把好奇心放在前面，别让恐惧掌舵  [Bǎ hǎoqíxīn fàng zài qiánmiàn, bié ràng kǒngjù zhǎngduò.]
• Smart questions change the whole day - 问得好，整天都会不一样  [Wèn de hǎo, zhěng tiān dōu huì bù yíyàng.]
• Small habits shape your destiny - 细小的习惯，决定大的方向  [Xìxiǎo de xíguàn, juédìng dà de fāngxiàng.]
• Choose respect over being right - 别急着赢，先学会尊重  [Bié jí zhe yíng, xiān xuéhuì zūnzhòng.]
• Pause, then pick the kind option - 先停一秒, 再选更善良的那条路  [Xiān tíng yī miǎo, zài xuǎn gèng shànliáng de nà tiáo lù.]

DOCTOR & PHARMACY · 医生与药房
• Where should I pick up meds? - 我去哪里取药？  [Wo qu na li qu yao?]
• Do I have refills left? - 我还能续开几次吗？  [Wo huan neng xu kai ji ci ma?]
• Is this medicine refrigerated? - 这个药需要冷藏吗？  [Zhe ge yao xu yao leng cang ma?]
